fields.statement: At 006e559c, with fake gh only: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'Ship|PRView|Plan' passes, including TestShipOpenPRRefusesForeignPR (open-pr refuses an OPEN, MERGED or CLOSED PR whose body names another change set or has no 'Change set' line, exit 3 naming #7, no pr create/edit, no ship state file) and TestShipCheckRefusesForeignPR (check with and without --settled, the wait step, refuses other-change-set, no-line and empty bodies in all three states, exit 3 naming #345, no state file); the existing ship tests, whose fake gh bodies name the run's change set, still pass, so an owned PR is tracked as before. The 32 testscripts the commit touched (run-ship-*, plan-workflow-*, ship-check-*, etc.) pass. Diff read: requirePROwned runs right after parsePRView in open-pr (before the merged-PR re-create path and after it) and in check, before any writeShipState; prOwnedBy matches the 'Change set <id>' line planSummary writes. An unfiltered go test ./internal/api/... hit the 600s default timeout on a machine at load ~17, which is unrelated to this leaf; the ship subset passed in 18s.
